cpu_precision: original BEGLIN native Q4/n8 packed kernels, 28 layers, 196 role tensors
research_question: At equal true incremental packed-weight byte budgets, does source-calibrated selection of original BEGLIN native 8-bit tensors outperform fixed 28-n8, equal-byte seeded random allocation and simple singleton-gain/byte greedy on genuinely new RACE items, without accuracy or serving cost regression?

proposed_calibration_data.role: select masks and fit any gains/interactions

proposed_eval_data.in_distribution: at least 128 distinct new RACE middle/test passages
proposed_eval_data.shift: at least 128 distinct new RACE high/test passages

primary_metric: paired mean full-vocab correct-answer next-token NLL (per passage), strongest applicable equal-byte baseline

statistics.predefine_multiplicity: Holm across primary candidate policy comparisons

acceptance_draft.NLL_vs_strongest_equal_byte_baseline: at least 2% relative paired mean improvement with adjusted 95% CI favoring candidate
acceptance_draft.accuracy: no >2 percentage-point regression; if CI too wide, INCONCLUSIVE
acceptance_draft.systems: budget obeyed and actual latency/RSS measured; do not claim runtime gain from weight ledger alone

state_approvals: Research draft only; fixed masks and future data must be fully enumerated and frozen in a separate signed run manifest before any confirmatory evaluations
dynamic_policy_gate: Only after static same-budget result. Per-input switching must be real native execution with measured switch overhead and no target-label lookahead.
